Independently reconstructed and accepted, with two standard inputs that the artifact leaves unstated but which I verified. (a) The lowest-weight surjection is correct: for an open immersion U into a smooth Y, a common smooth proper compactification X gives W_kH^k(U)=im(H^k(X)->H^k(U)) and im(H^k(X)->H^k(Y))=W_kH^k(Y), so W_kH^k(C^n) surjects onto W_kH^k(M_{g,n}); this is the point at which C^n (closed universal curve, R^1 pure of weight 1) rather than the punctured curve is used, which is exactly what avoids the mixed-R^1 hazard of FND-0020 and the extension hazard of FND-0037. (b) Writing H^k(C^n) as a direct sum of H^{k-|i|}(M_g; tensor R^{i_s}) as mixed Hodge structures needs more than E_2-degeneration, which only splits the associated graded; it is supplied by the Deninger-Murre relative Chow-Kunneth projectors built from the Q-divisor class c_1(omega_{C/M_g})/(2g-2), which are algebraic correspondences and hence MHS morphisms, so W_k is additive over the decomposition. (c) The i_s=0 summands restrict into Phi because M_{g,n}->C^{n-1} factors through M_{g,n-1}. (d) The i_s=2 statement is discussed in the strongest_attack; it is true here. (e) The stated isomorphism form additionally requires that the kernel of restriction meets the (1,...,1) Kunneth component exactly in the diagonal contraction images; the artifact asserts this from the Kunneth component of Delta_{ij} without the Gysin/weight-spectral-sequence exactness step. I accept the isomorphism as the standard statement, and record that only the containment W_kH^k(M_{g,n}) inside Phi+Psi plus vanishing of H^{k-n}(M_g;V^{tensor n}) is load-bearing downstream, so the symplectic Schur-Weyl and traceless-quotient identification carries no weight in the proof of the submitted theorem.

Verified, and verified to be robust to the weakest part of CLM-0135-1. Harer gives vcd(Mod_6)=4g-5=19; for a torsion-free finite-index normal Gamma one has cd(Gamma)=19, hence H^{20}(Gamma;M)=0 for EVERY Q[Gamma]-module M, and rational Hochschild-Serre with finite quotient gives H^{20}(Mod_6;V_lambda)=H^{20}(Gamma;V_lambda)^{Mod_6/Gamma}=0. This is genuine local-coefficient vanishing, not a transfer of constant-coefficient vanishing, so the FND-0164 hazard is not incurred. With k=26, n=6 the base degree is k-n=20>19, so the whole (1,...,1) term vanishes without needing the |lambda|=6 traceless refinement. I checked the stronger fact that every Kunneth multi-index i with |i|<=6 already sits in base degree 26-|i|>=20 and therefore vanishes, so every surviving summand has some i_s=2; the containment W_{26}H^{26}(M_{6,6}) inside Phi+Psi follows. The packet constraint FND-0035 is respected: no vanishing is drawn from 26=vcd(M_{6,6}).

vcd(PMod_{6,5})=4g-4+n=25 and 26>25, so H^{26}(M_{6,5};Q)=0 and Phi_{6,6}^{26}=0. This agrees with the mechanically verified FND-0036. I also checked the consistency point that Kunneth summands with some i_t=0 and |i|>=7 can be nonzero in H^{26}(C^6) yet restrict to zero on M_{6,6}, since their restriction factors through W_{26}H^{26}(M_{6,5})=0; no contradiction arises.

Algebraic generation of W_{24}H^{24}(M_{6,5};Q) by codimension-12 cycle classes forces Hodge type (12,12) throughout, hence a finite direct sum of Q(-12); finiteness holds because H^{24}(M_{6,5};Q) is finite dimensional. Given CLM-0135-2 and CLM-0135-3 the target equals Psi_{6,6}^{26}=sum_i psi_i Phi_{6,6}^{24}. Each psi_i is the restriction of a class on the smooth proper compactification and is an algebraic divisor class, hence spans a copy of Q(-1) inside W_2H^2. Phi_{6,6}^{24} is a sum of images of W_{24}H^{24}(M_{6,5}) under morphisms of mixed Hodge structures, so by CLM-0135-4 it is a finite direct sum of Q(-12). The cup-product maps Q(-1) tensor Q(-12)^a -> W_{26}H^{26} exhibit the target as a quotient of a finite direct sum of Q(-13), and FND-0033 (polarizable pure Q-Hodge structures of fixed weight form a semisimple abelian category, applied at weight 26) upgrades this to an actual Hodge-structure isomorphism W_{26}H^{26}(M_{6,6};Q)=Q(-13)^r, not merely a semisimplification. r=0 is admitted.

Q(-13)(21)=Q(8) and Q(-13) matches ordinary_tate_type while Q(8) matches open_bm_tate_type. All Tate twists check.

H^*(M_6;V_lambda)=H^*(Mod_6;V_lambda) rationally via contractibility of Teichmueller space; M_{g,n}=C^n minus diagonals holds as stacks because Aut of an object of the n-fold fibre product is exactly Aut(C,p_1,...,p_n); Poincare duality is applied only to the smooth DM stack M_{6,6}. Coefficients are Q throughout, including the finite-index transfer in the vcd argument and the semisimplicity argument; no integral statement is made or needed, so the integral hazard recorded for descent models (FND-0075) is not incurred. Borel-Moore versus ordinary degree, the (21) twist, and the Kunneth/Leray degree bookkeeping p+|i|=k with weight floor p+|i|=k were recomputed independently and are correct. Cup product with omega_s raises Leray degree by 2 and twists by Q(-1), matching the weight shift W_{24}->W_{26}.

finding_candidates.statement: Let g>=2, n>=1, C^n the n-fold fibre product of the closed universal curve over M_g, and k=vcd(M_{g,n})=4g-4+n. Because W_kH^k(M_{g,n}) is the image of W_kH^k(C^n) under the open restriction, because H^k(C^n) splits as a direct sum of mixed Hodge structures H^{k-|i|}(M_g; tensor_s R^{i_s}pi_*Q) over multi-indices i in {0,1,2}^n via the Deninger-Murre relative Chow-Kunneth projectors, and because H^p(M_g;L)=0 for every rational local system L and every p>vcd(M_g)=4g-5, every multi-index with |i|<=n sits in base degree k-|i|>=4g-4>4g-5 and vanishes; hence every surviving summand has some i_s=2 and W_{vcd}H^{vcd}(M_{g,n};Q)=sum_i psi_i sum_j pi_j^* W_{vcd-2}H^{vcd-2}(M_{g,n-1};Q). The peel is available because vcd(M_{g,n})-n=4g-4 exceeds vcd(M_g)=4g-5 by exactly one for every n>=1. Consequently the exact ordinary target is Tate whenever W_{vcd-2}H^{vcd-2}(M_{g,n-1};Q) is Tate, which the recorded CKgP range supplies exactly when n-1<=c(g).

finding_candidates.statement: On the n-fold fibre product C^n of the universal curve over M_g, the class omega_s=pr_s^* c_1(omega_{C/M_g}) is not homogeneous for the Kunneth multi-index: it decomposes as a_s+b_s+c_s with a_s in H^2(M_g) (slot value 0), b_s in H^1(M_g;V) (slot value 1) and c_s the R^2 component (slot value 2, coefficient 2g-2). Only c_s carries the i_s=0 to i_s=2 isomorphism, so any argument of the form 'multiplication by psi_s spans the i_s=2 summands modulo the summands with some slot 0' must dispose of the slot-1 cross term b_s. Two disposals are valid: H^1(Mod_g;H_1(Sigma_g;Q))=0 for g>=2 (Morita: the integral group is Z/(2g-2)), which makes b_s=0 identically; or a downward induction on |i| using A_i=c_s B_{i'} inside omega_s B_{i'}+A_{i'}+A_{i''} with |i''|=|i|-1 and the base case A_j=0 for k-|j|>vcd(M_g).

strongest_attack: Strongest attack: the omega_s inhomogeneity attack on the i_s=2 step of Section 1, which is the single load-bearing sentence whose written justification is incomplete. The artifact says 'Modulo those summands [the ones with some i_s=0], multiplication by psi_s spans the summands having i_s=2, because psi_s restricts to the nonzero canonical class in H^2 of the fibre.' On C^n the operative class is omega_s=pr_s^* c_1(omega_{C/M_g}), and omega_s is NOT homogeneous for the Kunneth multi-index: its Leray components lie in H^2(M_g) (slot value 0), H^1(M_g;V) (slot value 1), and H^0(M_g;Q(-1)) (slot value 2, with coefficient 2g-2). Only the last component maps the i_s=0 summand isomorphically onto the i_s=2 summand. Hence omega_s times an i_s=0 class equals the wanted i_s=2 class PLUS an i_s=0 error PLUS an i_s=1 error, and the i_s=1 error is not 'one of those summands', so the quoted sentence does not by itself deliver the containment of the i_s=2 summands in Psi. Since every surviving summand at (6,6,26) has some i_s=2, this containment is exactly what carries equation (5), and (5) carries the theorem. The attack nevertheless fails, for two independent reasons that I verified rather than assumed. First, the i_s=1 error term vanishes identically here: its coefficient is the H^1(M_g;V) component of c_1(omega_{C/M_g}), and by Morita's computation H^1(Mod_g;H_1(Sigma_g;Z)) is Z/(2g-2), so H^1(M_6;V_Q)=0 and omega_s=a_s+c_s exactly. Second, even without that input the containment follows by a purely formal downward induction: writing A_i for the multi-index summand of W_{26}H^{26}(C^6) and B_{i'} for the degree-24 summand with slot s reset to 0, one has A_i=c_s B_{i'} inside omega_s B_{i'}+A_{i'}+A_{i''} where i'' has slot s equal to 1 and |i''|=|i|-1; restriction sends omega_s B_{i'} into psi_s pi_s^* W_{24}H^{24}(M_{6,5}) (inside Psi) and A_{i'} to zero (slot s is 0, so it factors through W_{26}H^{26}(M_{6,5})=0), and A_{i''} is handled by induction, the base case being A_j=0 whenever |j|<=6 because the base degree 26-|j| then exceeds vcd(M_6)=19. Both repairs are two lines; the theorem survives. Runner-up attacks, all of which also failed. (i) Kernel direction of formula (1): identifying the kernel of restriction on the (1,...,1) component with the symplectic contraction images needs the Gysin/weight-spectral-sequence exactness for the diagonal divisors, which the artifact asserts from a Kunneth-component computation only; this is the concern that a pending candidate raised against an earlier C^n attempt (ATT-0017/REV-0023). It does not bite, because the proof of the submitted theorem uses only the containment direction plus outright vanishing of H^{20}(M_6;V^{tensor 6}), so the traceless/Schur-Weyl identification is decorative. (ii) Direct-sum versus filtration: E_2-degeneration splits only the associated graded, so 'H^k(C^n) = direct sum' needs the Deninger-Murre projectors to be an MHS splitting; those projectors exist over M_g with Q coefficients using c_1(omega_{C/M_g})/(2g-2), so W_26 is additive as used. (iii) Weight bookkeeping: I re-derived that every summand of H^{26}(C^6) has weights at least 26, so W_26 is the lowest-weight part everywhere and no summand can leak below the target weight; and that H^{20}(M_6;-) vanishes for ALL local systems, so the vanishing does not depend on the |lambda|=6 refinement. (iv) Blocked-route and citation hygiene: the artifact runs on the packet-blocked 'vcd-only-vanishing' route and declares new input, but its declared evidence ids (FND-0035, FND-0036, THM-0005) are not the quotient formula, and the cited 'SRC-0002 Lemma 3.1' is not a packet-recorded locator; this is a provenance defect only, since Section 1 proves the formula independently and says so. (v) Too-good-to-be-true test: the route generalises to W_{vcd}H^{vcd}(M_{g,n}) for all g>=2, n>=1 and would resolve (3,12), (5,8) and (7,4) as well, which is a reason for suspicion. I checked the boundary instead of the intuition: the route needs CKgP at n-1, and the residual list has n=c(g)+1 in exactly these four cases, while (8,0) and (8,1) sit at vcd-1 (so the peel gives base degree 27=vcd(M_8), no vanishing) and (8,2) has no recorded c(8). The method therefore terminates precisely at genus 8, which is consistent with degree 16 remaining open, rather than proving too much. (vi) Standard-hazard sweep: stack versus coarse, Q versus Z, BM versus ordinary degree, the (21) twist, Gysin and Kunneth shifts, differentials, graph automorphisms, predicted motives, pure-Tate-to-algebraic upgrades, and omitted stable pairs were each attacked and none yields a defect. Verdict: confirmed, with the omega_s inhomogeneity omission recorded as a finding candidate so downstream artifacts state the missing line rather than inherit it.
theorem_statement: The exact group W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6};Q), equivalently W_{26}H^{26}(M_{6,6};Q)(21), is a direct sum of Q(8); a disproof must exhibit a surviving non-Tate summand in this exact group.
